newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-LEKS BUYS MAJOR STAKE IN LATVIAN SAULES LAIKS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-LEKS BUYS MAJOR STAKE IN LATVIAN SAULES LAIKS.

text.p: Leks Insurance, a subsidiary of Tallinna Pank , has bought a major stake in Latvian non-life insurer Saules Laiks, Aripaev newspaper said Tuesday.
Leks is the first Estonian insurance company to enter the Latvian insurance market.
Leks chairman Raul Kastan told the newspaper that Leks acquired 55 percent of shares in what is Latvia's fourth largest insurance company with a nominal value of 6.3 million kroons.
A quarter of Saules Laiks shares are held by Saules Banka. Tallinna Pank, the major shareholder in Leks, also has a 20 percent stake in Saules Banka.
"The Latvian insurance market is in the same situation Estonia had 3-1/2 to 4 years ago, not active, but ready to start," Aarne Orav, Leks finance director, told the newspaper.
Leks is also following the development of the Lithuanian market, the company said.
